extraction_notes: The p-channel signs are preserved in threshold, drain-current, drain-source-voltage, and body-diode scalar fields; curve axes use magnitudes explicitly labelled with | |.
RDS(on) table values are typical 0.430 ohm at -4.5 V/-1 A, 0.624 ohm at -2.5 V/-0.8 A, and 0.950 ohm at -1.8 V/-0.5 A; corresponding maximum values are 0.520, 0.700, and not separately tabulated.
The datasheet publishes switching times and gate leakage, but these are not represented by the strict extraction schema.
Curve points are direct readings from the published typical plots; no vendor SPICE model or fitted curve was used.
